text:
nate: Quick heads-up — I'm planning a rolling deploy of an adjusted autoscaling policy to gpu-pool-beta today 12:30 PDT. This is a smoothing/tolerance change (reduce thrash when bursty jobs arrive). Expected impact: brief scale-up smoothing, safer evictions. pinging @jess @miguel @lucy for smoke/rollback readiness. eng-deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window confirmed 12:30-13:00 PDT.
jess: acked. What's the exact change? snippet or PR?
miguel: can you paste the policy keys? need to know if this touches eviction thresholds. Also will the canary be 5%?
nate: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/982
Policy diff is minor — change from `scale_cooldown: 60s` to `scale_cooldown: 90s` and `burst_tolerance: 0.2` -> `0.35`. Canary will be 10% for the first 10m, then roll to 100% if metrics look good.
lucy: I can run smoke checks right after canary starts. I'll watch gpu-pool-beta-canary dashboards and evictions panel.
jess: smoke checklist pls so SRE knows what to hit quickly.
miguel: also flagging we should watch queue latency and pending_jobs count — those will show if smoothing introduces frontend latency.
nate: smoke checklist: 1) deploy canary (10%) 2) run a burst job set: `./scripts/loadtest --gpu 6 --duration 120` 3) check dashboards: `gpu_utilization`, `queue_latency_p50/p95`, `eviction_count` 4) verify no fatal OOM/killed pods 5) rollback if evictions > 5/min sustained or queue_p95 > baseline+200ms for >5m.
jess: I'll be ready to run the load test and tag results here. Miguel — if you can confirm rollback steps?
miguel: rollback is simple: revert PR, kick a policy rollout via API: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/pools/gpu-pool-beta/rollout -d '{"policy_ref":"stable"}'``` then restart scheduler: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/gpu-orchestrator`. Keep me on call if anything odd.
lucy: note — I already ran this policy in staging last night for 2h (no evictions spike). Will paste staging graph later.
eng-deploy-bot: canary started (10%) — 12:30:10 PDT.
jess: starting loadtest now. cmd: `./scripts/loadtest --target gpu-pool-beta-canary --concurrency 12`
nate: I'll watch the main dashboards. Miguel, Lucy — please flag either evictions or queue latency if you see them climb.
miguel: seeing a small bump in queue_p95 at t+3m (~120ms) but within expected. gpu_util steady.
lucy: no evictions so far. staging graphs posted: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd123/policy-staging?orgId=1
jess: loadtest finished — success 98/100 requests within latency SLO. Posting raw: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/loadtest/2076543210
nate: rolling to 50% at 12:42 now. Will let it run 6m.
miguel: continuing to monitor — no sustained evictions. queue_p95 trending down.
jess: 50% smoke checks green from my side.
lucy: thumbs up.
eng-deploy-bot: rollout to 100% scheduled — executing now.
nate: rolling to 100%. If anyone sees >5 evictions/min or queue_p95 > baseline+200ms for >5m, call rollback.
miguel: metrics look stable. No action.
jess: merging infra PR to record rollout: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/982 merged.
lucy: final checks done, marking this success. Will open a quick follow-up ticket to observe for 24h.
nate: thanks all — closing once CI notes are archived. If anything crops up, ping this thread and oncall. :thumbsup:
